name: Gin
source:
Taka is a hawk that is the animal companion of the incarcerated prosecutor Simon Blackquill, and often perches on his shoulder. Blackquill uses Taka in court to harass his opponents and witnesses. Taka is also used to relay information involving the cases Blackquill is involved in, carrying it in his beak.

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Taka]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
